integrity: The source supplies the Fraïssé class and the finite-parameter type-growth invariant. The exact count is proved by a threshold insertion argument and checked by exhaustive finite extension enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is a short consequence of the finite Ferrers-threshold representation, so an equivalent folklore observation may be unindexed.
Finite exhaustive verification supports the parametrization only through bounded sizes; the general theorem relies on the symbolic counting proof.
The Fraïssé property and the model-theoretic definition of the invariant are imported from Simon’s source.
title: Exact quadratic \(1\)-type profile of Simon’s monotone two-order Fraïssé limit
